meta_title: City Central Plumbing & Heating | Plumber Leicester
meta_description: City Central Plumbing & Heating Services offer expert plumbing and heating across Leicester. Gas Safe registered, fast response, free quotes. Call us today.
hero_eyebrow: Gas Safe Registered — Fast Response Across Leicester
hero_subhead: Leaks, boiler breakdowns, or heating problems — we respond fast so your home stays safe and warm.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Heating Services Across Leicester
services_subhead: From emergency call-outs to full boiler installations, we cover every plumbing and heating need for Leicester homeowners and landlords.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Replacement
services.desc: We supply and fit energy-efficient boilers from leading brands, tailored to your property's needs. All installations are Gas Safe certified and fully commissioned for your peace of mind.

services.title: Boiler Servicing & Repairs
services.desc: Annual boiler servicing keeps your heating running safely and efficiently, potentially cutting energy bills. We diagnose and repair faults fast, minimising disruption to your household.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing
services.desc: Burst pipes, severe leaks, or loss of hot water — we aim to reach you the same day across Leicester. No call-out charge; just straightforward, honest help when you need it most.

services.title: Central Heating Systems
services.desc: From full central heating installations to powerflushes and radiator upgrades, we improve the warmth and efficiency of your home. We work cleanly and tidy up fully on completion.

services.title: Bathroom & Wet Room Installation
services.desc: We transform bathrooms and wet rooms from design to finished installation, handling all plumbing and tiling groundwork. Quality fittings, watertight results, and a smooth project from start to finish.

services.title: Landlord Gas Safety Certificates
services.desc: Legally required annual CP12 gas safety inspections carried out by our Gas Safe registered engineers. We work around tenants' schedules and issue your certificate promptly on the day.

about_pullquote: Every job, big or small, gets the same care and attention.
about_para_1: City Central Plumbing & Heating Services has been serving homeowners, landlords, and businesses across Leicester for over a decade, operating from our base on Abbey Park Road in LE4. Founded on the belief that reliable, honest trades work was hard to find locally, we set out to change that — building a reputation one satisfied customer at a time.
about_para_2: We're Gas Safe registered and fully insured, which means every engineer who enters your home meets the highest safety standards in the industry. Our customers return to us because we're straightforward about pricing, punctual, and we always leave your home cleaner than we found it.
reviews_heading: What Leicester Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Absolutely brilliant service. Called City Central on a Monday morning with a leaking pipe and they were with me by lunchtime. Fixed quickly, no mess left behind, and the price was very fair. Will definitely use again.
reviews.author: Karen B.

reviews.text: Had a new boiler fitted by these lads last autumn. From the initial quote to the finished job they were professional, on time, and explained everything clearly. Heating has been perfect all winter. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: James T.

reviews.text: Really impressed. Needed a landlord gas safety certificate at short notice and they fitted me in within two days, worked around my tenant, and emailed the certificate the same afternoon. Exactly the kind of reliable service you want.
reviews.author: Priya S.
